name: Open Application
description: Use to launch or open desktop applications and web targets (WhatsApp, Chrome, Calculator, VS Code, YouTube, Settings, Notepad, CMD, Spotify, GitHub, Gmail, Firefox, Edge, Downloads). DO NOT use web_search for application launch requests. Required parameter: target (string app name). Returns application execution status string.

target.description: Allowlisted app or website target name: whatsapp, youtube, chrome, calculator, vscode, google, notepad, github, gmail, spotify, firefox, edge, or cmd.

source.description: Request source: voice, text, or llm.

dryRun.description: Validate and resolve the target without launching anything.
